claims.title: True intelligence -- counterfactual, context, microstructure, forward-graded, cross-sport
claims.claim: How many pregame win-prob points is each team's top player worth? Take the player's on/off net-rating, convert it to Elo with a single frozen constant, subtract it from the team's Elo, and re-price through the repo's own Elo->probability curve against a league-average opponent on a neutral floor.
